We are seeking a highly organised, strategic, and results-oriented Manager to support the CPO Office in driving the Product strategy and key business priorities.

Reporting to the Director, CPO Office, the role will translate strategic direction into actionable plans, coordinate cross-functional delivery, and ensure high-quality execution. The Manager will drive selected strategic initiatives, support governance and portfolio management, and prepare analysis and communications for senior leadership. The ideal candidate combines strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with the ability to bring structure to complex topics and drive progress across teams.

**Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Support the development and execution of the Product strategy, translating priorities into clear plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

• Drive selected strategic projects and workstreams on behalf of the CPO Office, ensuring effective planning, coordination, and on-time delivery.

• Manage governance processes, leadership forums, and portfolio reviews, ensuring key decisions, actions, risks, and dependencies are clearly captured and followed through.

• Conduct strategic analysis, scenario modelling, and business assessments to support leadership decision-making and prioritisation.

• Prepare high-quality executive presentations, decision papers, business cases, and updates for senior leadership and Board reviews.

• Partner with Product, Marketing, Finance, Commercial, and other cross-functional teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and accelerate execution.

• Coordinate across global, regional, and local teams to ensure strategic initiatives are commercially relevant, operationally feasible, and supported by clear accountability.

• Establish robust PMO practices and continuously improve planning, reporting, governance, and ways of working across the Product organisation.

• Support the Director in managing external consultants, research partners, and other specialist resources when required.

**Qualifications & Experience

**

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Strategy, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is an advantage.

• 5-8 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business transformation, strategic PMO, product strategy, or a related field.

• Experience working in a complex, cross-functional, and international organisation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguity and translate analysis into clear recommendations.

• Excellent project management, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level materials.

• Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working at pace across multiple priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 4B

Help shape a more efficient and resilient global vaccine distribution network

Can you turn complex logistics data into practical improvements?

Do you know how to challenge transport flows, strengthen supplier performance and uncover what drives distribution costs?

And would you like to build capabilities that continue to make a difference beyond your assignment?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Network Optimization Lead to improve our global distribution network and strengthen the tools, insights and ways of working behind it.

This position is initially established for approximately 12–18 months to deliver priority network improvements and build a lasting capability within Global Distribution & Logistics.

**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to take on a pivotal role in a growing organization and drive meaningful change in healthcare, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

As a Senior Planning Specialist, Global Planning, you will play a key role in strengthening and continuously improving Ambu’s global planning capabilities. You will combine data, process expertise and stakeholder collaboration to turn planning information into actionable insights that support better decisions on cost, efficiency, service, and inventory performance.

You will help shape and improve our global planning processes by identifying opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and translating best practices into scalable solutions. Working closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain, you will connect global standards and strategy with effective local execution.

This is more than an analytical role. You will act as a key driver of planning excellence, helping build best-in-class planning processes and enabling smarter, more efficient and resilient ways of working across our global operations.

**Key Responsibilities

****Your mission is to improve our global planning landscape through process excellence, data-driven insights and effective change implementation.

****More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Process Excellence: Assess and continuously improve global planning processes, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, standardization and scalability across regions.

• 
Change & Implementation: Lead and support implementation of new processes, tools and best practices, ensuring effective adoption and sustainable change across the orgnization.

• 
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain to align local execution with global planning standards, processes, and strategic priorities.

• 
Data & Insights: Transform complex planning data into clear, actionable insights that support global decision-making and improve cost, service and operational performance.

• 
Performance Management: Develop, maintain and optimize KPIs, reporting and dashboards to monitor planning performance, identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• 
Have 5-7+ years of experience within supply chain planning, planning excellence, process improvement, supply chain analytics, S&OP/IBP, or related areas.

• 
Have solid experience driving process improvements, standardization initiatives, or transformation projects in a complex international supply chain environment.

• 
Are comfortable translating data and business needs into actionable insights, recommendations, and scalable solutions.

• 
Thrive in a stakeholder-facing role and have a proven ability to influence and drive change across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

• 
Combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach and enjoy turning ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements.

• 
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• 
Experience from MedTech or another complex, regulated industry is an advantage.

Above all, you bring curiosity, ownership, and a passion for continuous improvement. You are naturally proactive, challenge the status quo constructively, and enjoy collaborating with others to turn insights into tangible business improvements. You are equally comfortable working with detailed analyses and broader strategic initiatives, and you thrive in environments where you can make a visible impact on processes and performance.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Turn photonic quantum processors into real-world value

At Sparrow Quantum, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of light-matter interfaces for quantum technology to enable state-of-the-art scalable photonic quantum systems.

Sparrow Quantum is building universal photonic quantum processors based on deterministic quantum emitters. We are looking for a Quantum Applications Scientist to build on Sparrow’s work on use cases and algorithms and to help push the frontier demonstrating what photonic quantum can do for real end users.

You will act as the bridge between our theory, experimental, and business teams and our end users. You will take an end user's problem, work out how our hardware can address it, and turn it into a concrete plan that you help execute together with the teams.

This is a technical role with a clear focus on applications. You have the theoretical depth to develop applications yourself, with an eye for the quantum algorithms behind them, the experimental insight to discuss feasibility with our experimentalists, and the overview to translate between what end users need and what our hardware can do. You are expected to take initiative and move from a loosely defined question to a workable solution.

Responsibilities of the role

• 
Identify and develop use cases and quantum algorithms for our demonstrator, from initial end-user needs to proof of concept

• 
Translate end-user problems into well-defined computational tasks, and assess where our hardware can offer value

• 
Discuss feasibility with our experimental team, and feedback which hardware capabilities matter most for applications

• 
Run and guide simulations of algorithms and use cases to benchmark performance and compare against classical approaches

• 
Join end-user meetings initiated by the business team as the technical bridge, and turn results into clear recommendations

• 
Work with the business team on proposals, demonstrations, partnerships, and funding applications

• 
Represent Sparrow Quantum at conferences, workshops, and end-user meetings

In brief, we offer a unique opportunity for a talented Quantum Applications Scientist to collaborate with world-leading professionals in the field. Your work will shape how end users apply our quantum hardware and help steer our technology towards the problems that matter most.

Required qualifications

• 
PhD in quantum physics or a closely related field, with a strong theoretical foundation, ideally with postdoctoral or industry experience

• 
Good understanding of quantum computing use cases and where they may offer an advantage, e.g. in optimization, machine learning or simulation, with an interest in the underlying algorithms

• 
Worked alongside experimentalists, giving you a solid sense of what is experimentally feasible

• 
Solid programming skills, e.g. in Python, for simulating and benchmarking algorithms

• 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-specialists, including end users and business stakeholders

Nice-to-have qualifications

• 
Experience with quantum photonics, quantum optics or photonic quantum computing

• 
Experience working with industry partners, customers or end users on applied projects

• 
Experience leading projects or supervising junior researchers

• 
Experience with collaborative R&D projects or funding applications

• 
Knowledge of boson sampling, measurement-based or fusion-based quantum computing

• 
A track record of publications in quantum technologies

Additionally, we expect that you thrive in a collaborative work environment and are inspired by the chance to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing.

Desired abilities & competencies

• 
Overview: you keep the big picture in view and connect technical detail to what matters for the end user and for Sparrow Quantum.

• 
Translator: you are equally comfortable discussing algorithms with theorists, feasibility with experimentalists and value with end users.

• 
Proactive and solution-oriented: you spot opportunities, take the first step, and come back with options rather than obstacles.

• 
Constructive challenger: you are confident challenging assumptions, just as open to having your own challenged, and look for solutions that work both for the end user and for our hardware.

What we offer

• 
Passionate international team and high individual impact: Join a high-performance team of dynamic and highly motivated international professionals working towards photonic quantum computing. Your innovative ideas, unique perspectives, and unwavering drive to succeed are essential to the team and will have a direct impact on the future of our organization.

• 
Cutting-edge projects and world-renowned collaborators: Collaborate with world-renowned companies and researchers, working on cutting-edge projects that will shape the future of quantum technology. You will contribute to scientific publication, represent the company at conferences, and have the possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing.

• 
Personal and professional growth: Expect a steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the border between research and industry. Our commitment to your growth and development is reflected in our supportive culture, which includes group-based knowledge transfer, skill development, and opportunities for training and mentorship.

• 
Attractive compensation and career advancement opportunities: Receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with your qualifications, with ample opportunities to advance your career and achieve your professional goals.

• 
Inclusive and positive work culture: Become part of a positive and inclusive work culture where we build meaningful relationships and celebrate one another and our achievements. Our work culture emphasizes work-life balance, with generous vacation time, flexible working hours with up to 10-20% working from home, lunch paid by the company, and a focus on employee well-being.

How to apply

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

How to apply: Scroll down to apply with your CV and a short cover letter (in English).

Application deadline: November 15.

Starting date: As soon as possible.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis

Short-listed candidates will be invited for an in-person interview in Copenhagen. Travel and accommodation will be covered.

For questions, contact Larissa Vertchenko.

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company dedicated to advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies. We are recognized globally for our high-performance single-photon sources and our foundational contributions to the quantum internet and quantum computing.

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into

the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global ESG Engineer to join AAK’s Global Operations team and help drive the implementation of our operational ESG strategy across our global manufacturing network.

As the technical ESG expert within Global Operations, you will translate AAK’s sustainability ambitions into practical engineering standards, measurable KPIs and improvement programmes. Your focus will be on identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, optimise water and waste, and improve the overall resource efficiency of our operations.

Working closely with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS, Sustainability and regional teams, you will develop consistent approaches to ESG performance, strengthen the quality of our data and support sites in delivering measurable environmental and financial benefits.

This is a hands-on, global role where you will combine technical expertise, data-driven insight and stakeholder management to create scalable solutions across AAK’s manufacturing network. You will also play an important role in developing digital ESG reporting capabilities and embedding continuous improvement into our operations.

**Responsibilities

**

• Identify and prioritise ESG improvement opportunities across AAK’s manufacturing network, with a focus on energy, carbon, water, waste and resource efficiency.

• Co-develop and implement global engineering standards, technical specifications, methodologies and best practices that support consistent ESG performance.

• Work with manufacturing sites to assess technical solutions, develop business cases and quantify the environmental, energy and financial benefits of improvement projects.

• Translate global ESG targets into practical site-level roadmaps, KPIs, improvement projects and implementation plans.

• Drive the deployment of energy monitoring, carbon tracking and digital ESG data solutions to improve data quality, transparency and decision-making.

• Collaborate with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS and Sustainability to embed ESG improvements into capital projects and daily operations.

• Use operational data and performance analysis to identify trends, improvement opportunities and priorities across regions.

• Track project progress, verify delivered benefits and share best practices and lessons learned across the global manufacturing network.

• Support the development of consistent ESG reporting and data management processes, ensuring reliable information for internal and external reporting requirements.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies, ESG standards and regulatory developments, translating relevant changes into practical improvements for AAK’s operations.

**About You

**

• Degree in Chemical, Process, Energy, Environmental, Carbon & Net Zero Engineering or a related technical discipline, with 5–8+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial utilities, energy systems and operational environments, ideally with experience across multiple sites.

• Proven experience delivering ESG, sustainability, energy efficiency or carbon reduction programmes within manufacturing.

• Strong expertise in energy monitoring and reduction methodologies, with knowledge of approaches such as Pinch Analysis and experience calculating energy, carbon and financial savings.

• Good understanding of carbon accounting, Net Zero and ESG reporting frameworks, including GHG Protocol, CSRD, ESRS, SBTi, CDP and ESG Taxonomy.

• Experience developing engineering standards, technical specifications, project business cases, payback calculations and relevant engineering calculations.

• Strong data and digital capability, including experience with KPI reporting systems, data collection and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.

• Excellent project management, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and organisational levels.

• Structured, analytical and hands-on, with the credibility to engage both with site teams and senior leadership.

• Fluent in English and willing to travel internationally, with approximately 20–30% travel expected.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

JMP, a subsidiary of SAS, is committed to empowering scientists and engineers via our world-class family of statistical software products. For over 35 years, JMP has enabled customers to speed new drugs to market, to design better products and processes, and to figure out how to restore ecosystems. Advancements are made when brilliant people use JMP statistical discovery software to see what they’ve not seen before. If you are a problem solver, a connector, and someone who enjoys helping others, then you might just be the next person to join this dynamic, growing, and global team.

About the job

We are looking to hire an experienced New Business Salesperson to join our successful sales team, selling JMP software to both new and existing customers. To join this team the successful candidate will need to prove their record of consistently over-achieving sales targets while helping their customers to deliver long-term value from the use of their products.

You will be responsible for finding new business and managing existing accounts where you will have ownership of the full sales cycle through to close. You will be responsible for sales of JMP software products in a high volume, multi-tasking sales environment.

You will work with the JMP Sales Team to demonstrate and prove JMP’s customer value and drive new business across Ireland and Nordics.

As an Account Executive, you will:

• Create opportunities and customer alignment to JMP’s likely customer profile.

• Prospect within the assigned sales territory to uncover business needs.

• Help define and deliver the territory and account management plan; identify new target accounts with high "close" potential, qualify sales opportunities and accurately forecast your pipeline of qualified sales opportunities to deliver JMP software sales revenue.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of engineering, from mechanical design and prototyping to testing and integration with electronics and software. With a solid foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering and a curiosity to learn, you’ll build hands-on experience while contributing to meaningful product innovation from day one.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work across a variety of development activities, gaining exposure to different engineering disciplines while helping bring new ideas and technologies to life.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Supporting the development of new sensing products and technology platforms from concept generation through prototype development and testing

• Creating CAD models, drawings, fixtures, mechanical components, and development tooling to support new product designs

• Building, assembling, and evaluating prototypes, while collecting and analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

• Collaborating with engineers across mechanical, electronics, software, and systems disciplines to mature new concepts and solve technical challenges

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills across product development and explore different technical disciplines based on your strengths and interests.

**What We're Looking For

**You don’t need to have experience in every area of the role. What matters most is a strong mechanical foundation, a practical mindset, and the curiosity and motivation to keep learning.

To be successful in this role, we would expect you to have:

• A BSc or MSc degree in Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• A solid understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals

• Experience using CAD tools for design and engineering documentation

• Practical, hands-on engineering experience gained through work, university projects, internships, or personal projects

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in developing your skills across different engineering disciplines

It Would Be An Advantage If You Have Gained Exposure To One Or More Of The Following Through Work, Studies, Projects, Or Personal Interests

• Product development

• Prototyping and testing

• Electronics and sensors

• Software development

**What You'll Get From Us

**You’ll join an environment where collaboration, learning, and continuous development are part of how we work, with the opportunity to broaden your experience as you grow in the role.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Developing your own client networks

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

**What You'll Bring

**You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

**To Fit In At The Tech Collective, You Should

**

• Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

**What We Offer

**On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

**How To Apply

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

**For Questions, Reach Out To

**

• Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 27 14 55 56

• Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 25 53 19 98

**About Us

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

Global Business Development Manager

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

**About The Role

**We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s growing Next Generation Products team. In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. Moreover, you will be responsible for shaping and managing our global product portfolio while identifying strategic business opportunities to drive global growth. You will work cross-functionally to deliver and execute portfolio strategies & business development opportunities that help grow our brands and company.

Your role as a self-reliant professional is crucial in our fast-paced environment. A key part of your role will involve ensuring clear communication and alignment within the organization, while fostering robust professional relationships. You will be reporting to the Head of Business Development.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

****Lead Category Development

**

• Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for next generation products, ensuring alignment with consumer preferences and market trends.

• Analyzing market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats for the brand and category portfolio to improve performance & profitability.

• Evaluate the performance of the portfolio and adjust as needed to ensure it continues to deliver growth and profitability.

**Business Growth & Development

**

• Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, including market expansions, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop and execute business development initiatives that accelerate revenue growth and expand market presence.

• Leverage data and market insights to continuously evolve the product portfolio, ensuring the company remains ahead of industry trends.

• Utilize market research and consumer insights for the development of the next generation products portfolio strategy and to define its role and roadmap.

**Global Collaboration

**

• Work closely with regional and local teams to adapt portfolio strategies to local market needs and ensure the successful global rollout of new products.

• Ensure a cohesive approach to portfolio management and business development across markets, driving synergies and efficiencies globally.

**New Business Opportunities

**

• Identify and assess emerging trends and consumer needs to develop new product categories that align with the company's strategic goals.

• Lead the exploration and validation of new business ideas through market research, pilot programs, and feasibility studies.

• Develop business cases for new category initiatives, including market analysis, financial projections, and risk assessments.

• Collaborate with R&D, marketing, and sales teams to bring new product categories from concept to market launch.

• Establish strategic partnerships and alliances to support the development and growth of new categories.

• Monitor and evaluate the performance of new categories, making data-driven adjustments to ensure their success and profitability.

**WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WILL BE REQUIRED?

**

• 3-5 years of experience in business development and/or project management, ideally within multinational FMCG companies. Global/regional experience is preferred.

• Strong analytical skills and strategic thinking with a track record of identifying and capitalizing on growth opportunities.

• Deep understanding of consumer behaviour, what drives their decisions and how we can adjust our strategies to fit their needs and expectations.

• Excellent project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams & influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong communication and relationship-building abilities across diverse global teams.

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills and proven experience in utilizing data analytics tools.

• Fluency in English and ability to travel up 10-15% of the time.

Working At STG & What To Expect At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 615.000 DKK to 750.000 DKK/yearly corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

**Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant

• Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

**Position, purpose & impact

**As a Support Engineer in Global Tech Support, you will provide hands-on, customer-facing technical support that helps our customers operate Queue-it reliably during business-critical moments. Reporting to the Head of Global Tech Support, you'll join a global, collaborative support organization working across regions and cultures.

This role bridges customer needs with technically sound solutions - validating feasibility, answering technical questions, and guiding customers through supported implementation patterns. You'll troubleshoot incidents and product or integration issues with a calm, structured, and analytical approach, and contribute to proactive Event Support activities delivered together with Pre-sales & Solutions as part of Queue-it's professional services offering. This is a hands‑on role for someone who takes ownership and cares deeply about clear communication and reliable customer outcomes.

**Your toolkit

****Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience

**

• 1–3 years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, web engineering, or a similar customer‑facing technical role.

**Skills

**

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Solid understanding of web fundamentals and delivery concepts, including HTTP, headers, cookies, caching, load balancing, and basic networking.

• Technical proficiency within the web communication knowledge domain and the ability to understand customer integrations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks or customers in parallel in a structured way.

• Strong collaboration skills for working effectively with internal teams, including Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other GTM teams.

**Preferred

**

• Programming or scripting experience, such as JavaScript, .NET, Java, PHP, or Lua, mainly for troubleshooting and understanding customer integrations.

• Familiarity with CDN and edge delivery technologies such as Akamai, Cloudflare, or Amazon CloudFront.

• Experience with ecommerce platforms, ticketing platforms, or high‑traffic web environments.

• AWS, Azure, or similar technical certifications.

**The role in action

**

• Provide technical support for Queue-it customers as part of a 24/7 follow‑the‑sun support setup, including incident handling, alert response, and ticket resolution.

• Troubleshoot issues related to Queue-it configuration, product usage, supported integrations, and customer implementations.

• Support customers with integration‑related questions across common web technologies and supported deployment patterns.

• Diagnose technical issues related to traffic protection, waiting room behavior, connectors, and customer implementations.

• Participate in proactive monitoring and support during high‑traffic customer events, launches, and sales as part of Queue‑it's Event Support service.

• Communicate clearly with customers throughout incidents and support cases, ensuring timely follow‑up, accurate updates, and resolution within agreed SLAs.

• Collaborate with Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other Go‑To‑Market teams during escalations and complex investigations.

• Produce clear technical documentation and internal knowledge‑sharing material within the role's domain knowledge.

**Why join the Queue

**In this role, you will be working from our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen - Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The office is designed to support both collaboration and focus, with open workspaces, quiet rooms, and areas dedicated to deep work. You'll also find a ping pong table, foosball, and regular social activities that bring colleagues together.

At Queue-it, you're trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strength-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You'll be part of a global, collaborative environment with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives are valued and teamwork across cultures is the norm. We prioritize professional growth, open dialogue, and creating a strong sense of community. Daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building are all part of the experience.

**What We're About

**At Queue-it, we help some of the world's biggest brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, Hermes and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room technology keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events – creating fairer and more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

But we're more than just software. We're a global team representing 40+ nationalities across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in the power of trust – not only in the digital experiences we protect, but in the culture we build together.

We take a strength-based approach to work, encouraging people to do what they do best and supporting them to thrive. You'll join a supportive, collaborative environment that values individuality, learning, and connection. And yes – we like to have fun too. From regular social events and celebrations to cultural and learning initiatives, we make time to connect and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Consultant - Fund Administration & Accounting
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

The role includes approximately 30-50 travel days annually across the Nordics.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.
